sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:39

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:39:1
items.html:
In the Rosh of AA, etc., his Bina, etc., descended below, to the phase of the throat: The meaning is that these AHP, from which the Nukva of AA was made, are included of ten Sefirot: GE and AHP, which are likewise regarded as anterior and posterior, for there are two discernments in them. The first, in that they were joined so as to complete the AHP of Keter, and this is regarded as the discernment of Galgalta ve Einayim in these AHP. The second is in that they expanded to become Mochin for AVI of Nekudim, and this is regarded as the discernment of AHP in these AHP. Therefore, at the time when the Nukva of Atik sorted these AHP for the sake of the Nukva of AA, she sorted only the discernment of GE, which are the discernments of Keter and Hochma of the AHP, since these belong to the discernment of the Keter of Nekudim, which is the Nukva of Atik. But Bina and ZON of the AHP, which are the NHY of Keter that became Mochin for AVI, she brought out of the Rosh of the Nukva of AA, to the discernment of a lower degree, that is, to the Guf of AA. For after they became Mochin in Hochma and Bina of Nekudim, they were counted rather as the degrees of AVI of Nekudim, and not as the degree of Keter. And therefore Bina came out, outside the Rosh of AA.
And besides this there is yet another weighty reason why Bina could not stand in the Rosh of AA, for this is the rule: whatever is not flawed on the side of the breaking received its correction from the new MA in wholeness and permanently, and it never departs from there. But in the vessels that are flawed on the side of the breaking, the Mochin do not endure permanently; rather, they come and go. And therefore the discernment of the AHP of the AHP, that is, their Bina and ZON, are counted as flawed with respect to the Rosh of AA, which received the level of Hochma from Atik, as above; and therefore she cannot receive this great light permanently in the Rosh of AA, and therefore she descended outside the Rosh.
And this is his saying, “Therefore she descended below, to the phase of the throat of AA, and being there farther away, she had the capacity to receive the light of Atik.” For in her descent to the throat she receives her Mochin in an impermanent way, since at times she joins with the Rosh into one Partzuf and she has the Mochin of GAR [first three] from AA, and at times she is not joined, and then she does not have the Mochin, as is written further along; and in such a manner she is fit to receive.
And there is yet a third reason, as the ARI writes, because “judgments always arouse from Bina.” The meaning is that you already know that the flaws go on increasing in the Partzufim (as the ARI writes here in item 38, and see the Inner Light above, page 624, the passage beginning “And with this you will understand”). For there are three discernments in them. The first is what came out at the beginning of the emanation, which were not flawed at all, and these Atik took. The second is what came out in Nekudim through the illumination of the Holam by way of the Tabur of AK, whence the GAR came in the discernment of face to back. And the third is the illumination of the Shuruk from the Yesod of AK, whence the GAR came from the discernment of face to face. And these three discernments apply only in the GAR of Nekudim; and afterwards there are the discernments of the ZAT of Nekudim, which were broken both anterior and posterior. See there. Now, the choicest of the discernment of the posterior of AVI is that which comes from the illumination of the Holam, through the illumination of the Tabur; and this illumination of the Holam did not reach the AHP from the side of Bina, and not even in the AHP of Keter, because Bina did not turn her face back to Aba to receive from him the illumination of Hochma and to complete her AHP, before the MAN [Mayin Nukvin] of the Shuruk, which she received from the Yesod of AK, had reached her. Thus all the discernments of the AHP of Bina are from the illumination of the bottom Hey, which is included in the Shuruk. And this is the secret of the words that judgments arouse from Bina. And understand this.
